newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Die Erste offers 5:12 shares to GiroCredit holders.
newsitem.headline: Die Erste offers 5:12 shares to GiroCredit holders.

text.p: Following the announcement last week of a merger of Die Erste and GiroCredit savings banks Die Erste said on Friday it would offer GiroCredit shareholders five new shares of Die Erste for 12 GiroCredit shares.
All preferred shares in Die Erste will be exchanged 1:1.

"All holders of preferred shares of GiroCredit and Die Erste will be offered the possibility to become ordinary shareholders with equal rights in the new top institute in the savings bank sector that has been born out of the merger of these two banks," Die Erste said in a statement.

Die Erste said it would additionally offer cash for shares at the bourse rate of June 26 1997. The bank said it would offer 543 schillings per share for preferred shares of Die Erste and 305 schillings for those of GiroCredit.
The offer runs from July 7 to 29. Subscription rights of holders of preferred shares in GiroCredit are valued at 40 schillings.
